name: Landing page navigation loads hero and enters studio workspace
description: Verify the landing page loads, dither curtain can be dismissed, and clicking OPEN THE ATELIER enters the studio editor.

planSteps.description: Click the skip badge labeled CLICK OR ESC TO SKIP in the top right to dismiss the introductory pixel curtain
Verify the hero section displays the headline A QUIET DESK TO DRAW, ANIMATE, & UNWIND and the primary button OPEN THE ATELIER
Click the OPEN THE ATELIER button
Verify the browser navigates to the /studio workspace displaying the PixiBun top header, left toolbar, and canvas viewport
